issue.summary: Automate EventHub Ticket Booking Using Playwright
issue.description: As a QA engineer, I want to automate EventHub ticket booking using Playwright so that the booking workflow and seat count can be verified automatically.

technicalRequirements: Generate automated test cases from this requirement.
Execute the tests and generate an HTML report.
Prepare the test code for a GitHub Pull Request.

testEnvironment.approvedIsolatedEnvironment: Local-only mock bound to loopback; browser requests outside 127.0.0.1:4173 are blocked and fail the test.
testEnvironment.reason: No Playwright or browser test was run. AC-01 through AC-07 are configured for the local mock, including state reset before each booking scenario. Booking scenarios affect only the loopback mock. The original live EventHub booking test remains a separate approval-guarded target.

preconditions: The local EventHub mock is started by the Playwright configuration.
actions: Navigate to the existing test's EventHub login URL.
assertions: The existing email placeholder is visible.
The existing Sign In button is visible.
selectorEvidence: getByPlaceholder('you@email.com') and getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' }) are used in tests/eventhub-booking.spec.js.

criteria.sourceText: Log in with valid test credentials.
criteria.testTitle: [AC-02] Log in with configured test credentials
preconditions: The local mock accepts the fixed dummy credentials declared in the generated test.
testData: qa@example.test and LocalMockOnly-123! are test-only dummy credentials accepted only by the local mock.
actions: Fill the evidenced email placeholder and password selector.
Click the evidenced Sign In button.
assertions: The page URL becomes the EventHub application root, matching the existing test.
criteria.sideEffects: local mock session creation; no booking
selectorEvidence: The existing test fills getByPlaceholder('you@email.com') and locator('#password'), clicks the Sign In button, and expects the application root URL.

preconditions: AC-02 authentication succeeds against the local mock, which seeds the Dilli Diwali Mela event.
testData: Dilli Diwali Mela is taken from the existing test; no new event name is introduced.
actions: Find the event card by its evidenced test ID and text.
Click the evidenced Book Now button to open the event details without submitting a booking.
assertions: The Book Now button is enabled.
The event details heading is visible.
criteria.sideEffects: read-only event selection; no booking submission
selectorEvidence: The existing test filters getByTestId('event-card') by 'Dilli Diwali Mela', clicks getByTestId('book-now-btn'), and asserts the matching heading.

criteria.sourceText: Record the available seat count before booking.
criteria.testTitle: [AC-04] Record the available seat count before booking
preconditions: AC-02 authentication succeeds and the seeded event is present in the local mock.
testData: The seat-count text format is read using the exact regular expression from the existing test.
actions: Read the evidenced event card text and parse its available-seat count.
assertions: A seat count matching the generated test's available, left, remaining, or still open text pattern is present.
The parsed count is a positive integer before booking.
selectorEvidence: The generated test uses getByTestId('event-card').filter({ hasText: 'Dilli Diwali Mela' }) and /(\d+)\s+seats?\s+(?:available|left|remaining|still open)/i.

preconditions: The local mock is started by the Playwright configuration.
Mock state is reset before the test.
testData: The local mock event and dummy customer form values are used only at 127.0.0.1:4173.
actions: Reset mock state, open the event booking form, verify exactly one ticket is selected, and submit the form once.
assertions: Exactly one booking request is sent with ticketCount=1.
The local mock accepts the booking with a successful response.
criteria.sideEffects: state-changing booking within the local mock only
selectorEvidence: The local mock form exposes #ticket-count, #customerName, [data-testid='customer-email'], #phone, and the Confirm Booking button.

preconditions: The local mock is started and reset before the test.
testData: Dummy customer form values are accepted only by the local mock.
actions: Submit exactly one ticket to the local mock once.
assertions: The 'Your tickets are reserved.' message is visible.
criteria.sideEffects: state-changing booking within the local mock only
selectorEvidence: The local mock confirmation response contains both asserted confirmation messages.

criteria.sourceText: Verify that the available seat count decreases by exactly one.
criteria.testTitle: [AC-07] Verify exactly one seat is deducted
preconditions: The local mock is started and reset before the test.
testData: The mock starts each booking test with its fixed local seat count of 25.
actions: Read the local mock seat count, submit exactly one ticket once, and read the updated count.
assertions: The selected and submitted ticket count is 1.
The updated seat count equals the initial count minus exactly one.
criteria.sideEffects: state-changing booking within the local mock only
selectorEvidence: The local mock event card exposes the seat count; the generated test parses it before and after the single booking.
